finding: Promotion-ladder and zwischenzug CLI operations accepted an omitted location, silently selecting network-wide data. The tactical-layer report rejected missing scope only after the CLI opened PostgreSQL. The two zwischenzug branches also imported an analytics automation module that does not exist; the implementation lives under services.feedback.
changes: Require a valid UUID location for tactical-layer reports before opening PostgreSQL.
Require an explicit location or --all-locations for promotion-ladder and zwischenzug CLI commands.
Reject combining a specific location with --all-locations; tactical-layer does not support all-locations.
all_location_behavior: Existing network-wide capability is preserved for promotion-ladder and zwischenzug behind explicit --all-locations.
limitations: This is CLI preflight coverage; it does not establish runtime tenant authorization for direct function callers.
No live database, provider, or candidate/legacy service was used.
